patch.value: GH-1540: MCP binaries ignore help and version probes before transport startup

External report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1540 against published 2026.10.21: pm-mcp --help exits silently and pm-mcp-http --help starts a listener instead of exiting. Source entry guards currently start each transport directly without parsing help. Report requests help/version before stdin reads or port binding, documented configuration and supported protocol versions, and npm/Bun executable acceptance. Intake records the source/report evidence; independent packaged reproduction and implementation remain to be done.

Handle --help and -h plus --version before transport startup; Describe supported configuration and protocol versions with a client example; Prove npm and Bun executable probes return promptly without side effects; Preserve normal stdio and HTTP startup behavior
Both MCP executable help and version probes return promptly without reading stdin or binding a listener, and report the supported transport configuration.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Packed acceptance caught a harness failure before delivery: the first npx --package <tarball> MCP probe exceeded its15-second budget while resolving/reifying the package, before executable output. Preserve the strict probe budget but reuse the already installed consumer: npx --prefix <consumer> --no -- <bin>, and bunx --bun from that consumer cwd. The separate cold package smoke still proves installation. This separates installer latency from executable startup rather than increasing a timeout or accepting an unexecuted probe. Prepare the scoped harness fix and apply after the current source-owning gate finishes.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Time executable discovery only after package installation is established. Cold npx/Bun resolution belongs to installation acceptance; a startup probe should hold stdin open or supply invalid transport configuration and reuse installed binaries so it cannot pass by starting the server.
